note: Owner 2026-10-28 digest rules (a), reviews 3 to 5: the saved copy's hold of a step (copies.pm _hold_of) and the lane check's (lane.ts holdOf) are two copies of one rule (with a job trigger the user wins: a person, a pronoun or a person's say anywhere, or a name, another wait, an ask or a need outside the job triggers, or a wait's object that goes past its job, holds the step on the user; with none, release-0.1.1b's reading; both copies read \w, \b and \d as ASCII and any space, a no-break one too, as a plain space), so they must agree word for word. copy_status cannot tell a user hold from a job hold, so this reads the wordings the TS lane test checks holdOf with (TRIGGERS: held on a job, USER_WAITS, APPROVAL_WAITS, USER_PARTS and TRADE_OFFS: held on the user, NOT_TRIGGERS and FREE_GAPS: free work; non-ASCII and no-break-space wordings among them) from plugin/tests/unit/lane.test.ts itself and checks that _hold_of gives each the same hold
